name: comp-150
blurb: Dark mode toggle using a native checkbox with animated Sun/Moon icons.
description: Dark/light mode toggle using plain HTML checkbox with Sun and Moon icons. Icons animate via peer selector. Includes aria-label for screen readers.
use_when: Theme switching in app headers or settings.
avoid_when: This manages local state only—integrate with a theme provider for actual theming.
a11y: Native checkbox with proper aria-label. Icons are aria-hidden. Full keyboard support. Focus visible ring.
